disposition_reason: Tables 1-3 print mean Fe, Pb, Cr, Zn, Ni and Cd for 20 bread brands from outlets and from bakeries in Makurdi and for three baking flours.

study.design: Market survey of the 20 most consumed bread brands, each sampled at bakeries and at distribution outlets, plus 3 flours
study.origin: Bread baked in Makurdi, Benue State, Nigeria
study.market: Bakeries and distribution outlets in North-bank, Wurukum, High-level, Wadata, Modern market, Gboko road, New GRA, GRA, Abu King Shulluwa Road and Kanshio, Makurdi
study.method: Oven drying at 60 °C, HCl/HClO4 (2:1) digestion of 1.0 g, flame AAS (Buck 210 VGP), AOAC 1990
study.qa: Three-standard calibration and blanks; triplicates; no CRM or recovery reported

controls.control: Bought at distribution outlets vs directly at bakeries
controls.outcome: Pb 0.010-0.66 mg/kg at outlets vs ND-0.355 mg/kg at bakeries; Ni 0.005-0.115 vs ND-0.010 mg/kg; Cd detected once (0.025 mg/kg) at outlets, never at bakeries

unresolved: Basis not labelled (samples analysed after oven drying).
Text says bakery Cr minimum is 0.090 mg/kg but Table 2 row D prints 0.045 ± 0.014.
Iron (0.24-1.48 mg/kg) and zinc (0.21-0.51 mg/kg) are far below typical bread values, and flour metals are about 10-fold below bread values, which raises analytical doubts; recorded as printed.
Collection dates and LOD not stated; 'sampled twice' but only one mean per brand per outlet type is printed.
Table 3 flour values nearly match the flour table of the same group's Jalingo paper (10.58578/mikailalsys.v2i1.2411, Table 1), raising a possible data-reuse concern.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: WHO (2001) permissible limits as printed in Table 4 (which repeats Table 1 values)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Fe 18 mg/day, Pb 0.2 mg/kg, Cr 0.3 mg/kg, Zn 0.2 mg/kg, Ni 5 µg/kg/day, Cd 0.2 mg/kg

source_record_corrections: Authors are printed surname-first ('Ikwebe Joseph & Bando Christopher David'); the same group cites itself as 'Bando, C. D., Ikwebe, J.', so the first author's surname is Ikwebe, not Joseph as in the manifest. Record uses authors [Ikwebe J, Bando CD]; source_id keeps the manifest surname.
